issues.title: Dangling External Module References
issues.why: The spec references external modules like `../03-error-manage/`, `../02-coding-guidelines/`, and `../04-database-conventions/` which are not provided in the context.

issues.title: Missing Concurrency/Large Input Constraints
issues.why: While it defines structural rules, it lacks constraints on maximum file sizes or handling of concurrent linter runs in CI/local environments.
issues.fix: Add a section to §10 or §97 defining file size limits (e.g., 1MB) and lockfile requirements for linter scripts.
